text.tspan: A sample of an ideal monatomic gas can be taken through each of the processes shown on the above graph of
pressure as a function of volume. Which of the following correctly ranks the magnitude of the change in internal
of the gas for each of the processes?
Correct. The internal energy of an ideal gas is directly proportional to its temperature. The largest change
corresponds to the largest temperature change
, the largest change in temperature corresponds to the largest change in the product
